target: gap to the previous bus of the same line < 25% of the planned gap (predicted only while the gap is still >= 50% of plan), at any of the next 10 stops

data.rule: trip-day excluded when its median delay (after repairing flat stop times) is > 30 min

alerting.chosen_by: highest F1 on the training days, each day predicted by a model that did not see it
alerting.baseline_rule: alert when the gap is below 60% of the planned gap
